name_reason: Follows fd2_<verb>_<descriptor> convention (compute + aoe_targets). 'aoe' is the term area-of-effect, not an address residue; no hex suffix. Name accurately reflects: paints an affected-tile overlay and gathers char-index targets within it. Established live name used across protos.h/globals.h and 8 callers.
purpose: Paint the affected-tile overlay for a spell/skill/weapon at a center tile, then collect the runtime_char indices standing on an affected tile whose team matches the requested filter.
logic_summary: count=0. If spell_range<0x10: floodfill movement-range (class-0 cost table) from (center_x,center_y) covering spell_range tiles via fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill; if aoe_radius!=0, any tile within manhattan aoe_radius of center is then set to 0xFF (excluded from scan). Else (spell_range>=0x10): orthogonal cross -- clear tile byte+7 to 0 along the x-stripe through center_y and the y-stripe through center_x, each extending +/-(spell_range-0x10) from center. Then scan all party_member_count runtime chars: skip dead (flag+5 bit 0) and chars on a 0xFF-marked tile; apply team_filter (0->team==0, 1->team!=0, 2->team==1, 3->team==2); for each match optionally write index byte to out_buf[count] and count++. Return count. Tile metadata lives in byte +7 of each 4-byte cell (shared overlay slot, written transiently).
signature: int fd2_compute_aoe_targets(uint32 center_x, uint32 center_y, uint32 out_buf, uint32 spell_range, uint32 aoe_radius, uint32 team_filter)

params.name: center_x
params.semantics: Center tile x of the spell/skill area. Caller passes candidate/cursor/AI-target tile x. Used as floodfill origin x and as the cross-stripe pivot.
params.reason: Accurate; matches all caller arg1 (candidate_x / cursor_world_x / ai_best_spell_target_x). Note: Ghidra labels this param_1 (mis-ordered/jumbled labels); src name is the correct semantic.

params.name: center_y
params.semantics: Center tile y of the spell/skill area. Floodfill origin y and cross-stripe pivot.
params.reason: Accurate; matches all caller arg2. Ghidra labels it param_2.

params.name: out_buf
params.semantics: Optional output buffer; if non-zero, matching char indices are written as bytes (out_buf[count]). If 0, function only counts.
params.reason: Accurate; matches caller arg3 (target_id_buffer / target_buf). Ghidra labels it param_3.

params.name: spell_range
params.semantics: Area-shape selector. <0x10 -> floodfill range = this many tiles; >=0x10 -> orthogonal cross with extent (spell_range-0x10). Callers source it from the item/spell effect entry (weapon_aoe_y, pSpell[+3], pSpell[+4]).
params.reason: Accurate for the function's internal semantics (range/shape control). Ghidra mislabels this param as 'caster_x'; src name is correct.

params.name: aoe_radius
params.semantics: Manhattan radius of the AoE exclusion bubble in mode 1 (tiles within < aoe_radius of center are marked 0xFF and excluded). 0 = no bubble. Unused in mode 2.
params.reason: Accurate; matches body usage (if aoe_radius!=0 ... < aoe_radius). Ghidra mislabels this param as 'caster_y'; src name is correct.

params.name: team_filter
params.semantics: Team selector against runtime_char team byte +6 (0=enemy,1=NPC ally,2=player): 0->enemies only, 1->any ally, 2->NPC allies only, 3->players only.
params.reason: Accurate; matches the 4-way team test in body. Encoding confirmed against fd2-knowledge runtime_char layout (team field 00=enemy/01=NPC ally/02=player). Ghidra mislabels this param as 'pOut_ids'; src name is correct.

returns.semantics: Count of chars found on an affected tile matching team_filter (also the number of bytes written to out_buf when out_buf != 0).

writes_globals: data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr (writes overlay byte +7 of cells transiently; pointer itself not modified)
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but too terse: it omitted the two distinct area-shape modes (floodfill range vs orthogonal cross, gated by spell_range vs 0x10), the aoe_radius exclusion-bubble behavior, and the team_filter encoding -- the load-bearing semantics for an internally-polymorphic function with cyclomatic complexity 22.
notes: Verified 3 representative callers (fd2_ai_score_physical_attack, fd2_spell_selection_menu_main, fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell) -- all confirm arg order matches src param names (center_x, center_y, out_buf, spell_range/shape, aoe_radius, team_filter). Ghidra's decompiled param labels are jumbled (param_1/param_2/param_3/caster_x/caster_y/pOut_ids) and do NOT match true semantics; the src names and the plate's documented order are correct. Team encoding cross-checked against fd2-knowledge runtime_char (team byte: 0=enemy,1=NPC ally,2=player; src reads at +6 == guide 0x0E since src base = guide base + 8). The (byte) casts on tile-map/attr pointers in the fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill call are a Ghidra callee-signature artifact (full 32-bit pointers passed on stack), not a logic concern in this function. Plate comment already accurately documents both modes + team filter + behavior; left untouched (no contradiction).
